title: infra's machine-wide profile is read from $HOME/.config/devbin/infra.yaml whatever XDG_CONFIG_HOME says (from 0243's review)
body:
infra looks for a machine-wide profile at `$HOME/.config/devbin/infra.yaml`, written out by hand, so an XDG_CONFIG_HOME that points elsewhere is not followed. The path is spelled in lib/infra:44 (the search order a refusal prints) and :68 (the search itself), and again in lib/cmd/infra:89 (the usage), lib/infra.reference.yaml:13 and lib/pages/infra.md:23. infra-profile.bats:193 asserts `.config/devbin`. 0243 adds xdg_dir, one statement of the XDG defaults. Raised by cc's critic-shell review of 0243 as outside its scope. vc read each site on main at 9fecb053 and filed it on 2026-10-27.

## Fix

infra's machine-wide profile is `devbin/infra.yaml` under the XDG config directory, which xdg_dir answers: XDG_CONFIG_HOME when it is absolute, `~/.config` otherwise. One function names it, and both the search and the printed order ask it. The usage, the reference and the page name it as `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/devbin/infra.yaml` (default `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml`). With XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset or relative, the profile at `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml` is found as before.

## Done when

1. With XDG_CONFIG_HOME set to an absolute directory holding `devbin/infra.yaml`, infra reads that profile, and its no-profile refusal lists that path. With XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset, `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml` is read as before. An arm for each, the first red on main.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (infra-profile and infra's other files, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

It builds after 0243, which adds xdg_dir.

## Resolution

Fixed at 05b5a5cc7880c0f41438a2a2ddb7d29220a7a639, landed on main by vc with the rest of C (fb66b479..7565e2a2) on hv's GO of 29 Oct, as cc banked it. infra's machine-wide profile is devbin/infra.yaml under the XDG config directory, read through xdg_dir, so an absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME is followed.

- **One function names it.** lib/infra's `infra_machine_profile` prints devbin/infra.yaml under `xdg_dir config`: XDG_CONFIG_HOME when it is absolute, `~/.config` otherwise. The search (`infra_resolve_profile`) and the order a refusal prints (`infra_profile_paths`) both ask it, where each had spelled `$HOME/.config/devbin/infra.yaml` by hand. With no XDG config directory at all (neither XDG_CONFIG_HOME nor HOME absolute), the search skips it and the printed order says the path was not looked for, and why.
- **The words.** infra's usage (lib/cmd/infra), lib/infra.reference.yaml and lib/pages/infra.md name it as `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/devbin/infra.yaml`, default `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml`, and xdg_dir's comment in lib/helpers names lib/infra as a reader.
- **The tests' machine.** tests/lib/test_helper.bash's `devbin_isolate_machine` unsets the runner's XDG_CONFIG_HOME beside HOME, so no arm reads the runner's own profile.

- **Done when 1.** infra-profile.bats's "the machine-wide profile is devbin/infra.yaml under an absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME, found there and named in the search order (0272)" runs `infra show` with XDG_CONFIG_HOME absolute: with no profile there the refusal lists `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/devbin/infra.yaml` and not the home's `.config/devbin`, and with one there that profile is read. "with XDG_CONFIG_HOME empty or relative, the machine-wide profile is ~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml, as before (0272)" reads `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml` with XDG_CONFIG_HOME empty and with it relative. Unset, the case the test helper now gives every arm, is held by "a missing profile names EVERY path it tried, not just the last", whose refusal still names `.config/devbin`; that arm carries no (0272) tag, so it runs in the light phase, where infra-profile.bats runs whole.
- **Done when 2.** The landing suite: C's arms phase, in estate slot 01M61TNPWJTZMYNDBPTEZZ54ZG on molt-vc's grant, ran every arm tagged with one of the bank's eight issues on main 09c7d61a, file by file, from 2026-10-28 18:00Z to 18:08Z: in the red clone f4b30a50, main's lib with the bank's tests, under BSD; then at the bank's tip 53c92332 under BSD, and again with GNU coreutils, findutils, sed and grep first on PATH (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s5e/runs/arms/, summary in s5e/arms.out). Of 0272's two arms, the XDG_CONFIG_HOME arm failed in the red clone, red on main as Done when 1 asks, and the as-before arm passed there; both passed under BSD and GNU. C was stopped on hv's word in its light phase, so its whole-file legs, the tree scans among them, did not finish; hv's runs on main took them over. No later fix touched its code. hv's `dvb test all` on rhadamanth at 217adf65 ran every one of the 2777 tests bats counts in tests/unit once, and none failed (tmp/test/20261029-0817.bats.out, its .errors empty). K0116B, the full suite on kovacs at 4d1a76b0 with rustup's cargo first on PATH, as on CI's Ubuntu runner, is green, as vc read its seal. CI run 40851772728 on 4d1a76b0 and CI run 40860048152 on 25175386, the head 0.1.16 was cut from, are green on Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary. No critic leg ran on the landed commits.

- **CI:** run 40860048152 on the pushed head 25175386, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
